description: Curated corrections for the 'Object with Reference Décor Generator' capability. Independently maintained — no shared scope with corrections.v1.json (brand-activation infra) or corrections-simple.v1.json (staff/venue rules), neither of which apply here.

corrections.failureMode: The object's own branding, wrap, or surface text is repainted, color-graded, or corrupted while compositing the decor element
corrections.note: The object shown in IMAGE A is FINAL. Do not repaint, recolor, or alter any part of it, including all printed text, logos, and small badges. Reproduce the object pixel-faithful, exactly as it appears in IMAGE A.

corrections.failureMode: The decor element's structure, color, or material drifts from IMAGE B (e.g. wrong balloon colors, simplified structure)
corrections.note: The decor element's exact structure, exact colors, and exact materials must match IMAGE B faithfully — do not redesign, simplify, or recolor it to better match the object or the background.

corrections.failureMode: Output contains text overlays, borders or watermarks
corrections.note: No text overlays, no borders, no watermarks, no captions anywhere in the output image.
